notes: Private runtime composes existing ContentSection plus ArticleBody; ContentSection is the public fill pointer. heading binds to heading; revision {label,value} adapts to description; body typed paragraph/heading/list records adapt to ArticleBody children within ContentSection children. These bindings are adaptation points, not direct JSON prop equivalence.

The host owns the legal heading, revision label/value and every policy section. A short placeholder is supported while final Writer-authored policy text remains host-owned. The renderer supplies no policy wording beyond isolated specimen preview content.

Body accepts only paragraph/heading text and lists of text; React escapes text. Unknown node kinds and fields, arbitrary HTML and undeclared inputs are refused. Paragraph/list nodes use dir=auto and body headings render as h3 below the host heading at h2.

Requires an external Designer SectionFrame; the surrounding page must use a Designer Frame. No legal route, data fetching or document ownership is introduced. Source checks and consumer runtime qualification remain separate.

Descriptor only; source imports, token reads, shared anatomy, accessibility, contrast and consumer runtime conformance are unmeasured. Content bindings describe host adaptation points, not type-equivalent converters.
